summary: @HouseSmallBiz Think not about just the manufacturer but the Managed service providers who will all be in scope. This is not new. 32 CFR 2002 incorporates FIPS 199, FIPS 200, NIST-SP-800-53, NIST-SP-800-171, NIST SP-800-88
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@HouseSmallBiz Think not about just the manufacturer but the Managed service providers who will all be in scope.

This is not new.

32 CFR 2002 incorporates FIPS 199, FIPS 200, NIST-SP-800-53, NIST-SP-800-171, NIST SP-800-88
